purpose: Reference Location DNA for persistent place identity across Music Drama image sequences. No scenarios, prompts, or runtime generation.

section_5_location_identity_law.purpose: Same location_id must be described with consistent anchors across future scenarios to prevent location drift.

location_drift.mitigation: Bind scenario location text to location_id anchors; reuse visual, architectural, and color anchors per shot.

scene_mutation.mitigation: Lock persistent_objects and architectural_anchors across same-location multi-shot sequences.

environment_inconsistency.mitigation: Pair location_id with recommended_time_profiles and terrain_anchors for micro-environment stability.

same_place_multi_shot_requirement.policy: When consecutive shots share narrative place, reuse identical location_id and full anchor set from this library.
